title: Has Your Partner Demand Strategy Kept Up With Your Evolving Partner Ecosystem?
summary: B2B partner ecosystems are complex, yet organizations apply an outdated partner demand strategy across different partner business models.
body_markdown:
B2B partner ecosystems are becoming larger, more diverse, and more complex, yet some organizations continue to apply an outdated, single partner demand strategy across fundamentally different partner business models. The consequences are clear: Investments are misaligned, resources are spread inefficiently, partner engagement suffers, and demand performance falls short of expectations — the opposite of driving efficient growth with partners.


The need for change is already evident. According to Forrester’s Partner Ecosystem Marketing Survey, 2026, 70% of partner ecosystem marketing decision-makers plan to update their partner demand strategy within the next 12 months. Simply put, many partner demand strategies have failed to evolve alongside the partner ecosystems that they are intended to support. Thankfully, most decision-makers recognize the need for change.


## **Different Partners Require Different Demand Strategies**


Different partners create value differently. They follow different routes to market, bring distinct offerings to buyers, hold varying levels of demand influence, and possess widely different marketing capabilities. Yet many partner demand strategies continue to overlook these differences. A strategy designed for one partner can be ineffective, or even counterproductive, when applied to another. The answer is better alignment: Ensure that partner demand strategies are intentionally aligned to how each partner creates value and brings offerings to market.


## **Retire One-Size-Fits-All Approaches To Partner Demand**


More funding, more programs, and more partner demand activities will not solve a strategy built on outdated assumptions. The Forrester Ecosystem-Aligned Partner Demand Strategy Framework provides a blueprint for closing that gap. By applying the seven keys in the framework, partner ecosystem marketing leaders can move beyond one-size-fits-all approaches and build partner demand strategies tailored to unlock the realities of their unique partner ecosystem. The longer organizations wait, the greater the misalignment, wasted investment, and gap between partner ecosystem opportunity and partner demand performance.


## **Is Your Partner Demand Strategy Keeping Pace With Your Partner Ecosystem?**


If your partner ecosystem has expanded in size, diversity, or complexity over the past several years, ask yourself a simple question: *Has your partner demand strategy evolved along with it?* For many organizations, the answer is no. That needs to change.


Read Forrester’s report,[Implementing The Ecosystem-Aligned Partner Demand Strategy Framework](https://www.forrester.com/report/implementing-the-ecosystem-aligned-partner-demand-strategy-framework/RES202985) , and start modernizing your partner demand strategies before today’s alignment gap becomes tomorrow’s growth challenge.
